Shield Bashing +23%: +23% Enhancement bonus to your chance of a Secondary Shield Bash. This stacks with bonuses granted by any relevant feats.
Insightful Incite +59: +59% Insight bonus to increased threat generation from melee damage
Profane Lifeforce +49: +49 Profane bonus to Hit Points.
Legendary Conditioning +15%: You have a +15% Legendary bonus to Maximum Hit Points.
